mara: Quick note — were lifting embargo for the 'Latency at Scale' benchmark tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Need press triage, live monitoring, and the social thread queued. Assets + tracker: https://go.redwood.com/launch-assets :mega:

Diane: Ill handle press intake. Please add me to any reporter DMs and route interview requests to #press-surge. Who has the final headline?

Sam: Ops will run pre-publish smoke at 09:00 PT and validate site + sample generations. @oliver can you confirm CDN cache purge timing?

oliver: CDN purge scheduled at 09:58 PT, will confirm once propagation shows 200s. Ill stay on call 09:45-11:00 PT.

press-bot: Publish job scheduled: blog_publish_job#4499 at 10:00 PT (thread 1998901234). Auto-notify marketing-live and press-surge on run.

jin: Monitoring plan: 2-person rotation 09:45-12:00 PT on marketing-live. Escalate to eng-oncall + Diane if any media-related site errors or latency spikes.

mara: Please pin the canonical reporter Qs + approved quote into the tracker and tag any visibility tickets with 'press-visibility' and P0. Ill post final headline at 09:50 PT. :pray:
